name: the-Veil-Thread
clergy: the Veil-Wardens, scholars who map the Quiet's advance and advise the Reeve's court
attitude_to_magic: The Glimmer is the song that thins the Veil; the-Veil-Thread is the tension that holds or breaks it.

worship_by_species.name: the-Veil-Thread
worship_by_species.note: The Reeve's court consults the Veil-Wardens before expedition into the Ashlands; the Censer denies his existence.

worship_by_species.name: the-Stone-Seam
worship_by_species.note: The deep-folk feel the Veil as a seam in the earth; the-Veil-Thread is where the earth's skin is thinnest.

worship_by_species.name: the-Green-Edge
worship_by_species.note: The greenfolk say the Veil is the edge of the forest; when it thins, the old things return.

worship_by_species.name: the-Dune-Breath
worship_by_species.note: The desert's shifting dunes are his breath; when the wind stops, the Veil is at its thickest.
